title: Chippewa Valley Developer Group
theme: a recruiting commercial for the Chippewa Valley Developer Group (CVDG), a free monthly developer community in the Chippewa Valley, Wisconsin
music_prompt: upbeat modern indie-tech underscore, warm and community-driven, light percussion and bright synth, 110 bpm, instrumental only, absolutely no vocals

beats.say: You don't have to code alone.
The Chippewa Valley Developer Group is a community of developers right here in the valley.

show.prompt: a warm, welcoming meetup of software developers in a modern classroom, laptops open, someone presenting at a screen, people smiling and engaged, evening light, candid documentary photography, vertical composition

beats.say: We meet every month for open discussions and real presentations.
Whether you sling C sharp, play with Python, rock Ruby, or love JavaScript, you'll fit in great.
Students, professionals, and hobbyists are always welcome. And it's free.

show.prompt: a diverse group of software developers of different ages standing and laughing together after a tech talk, holding plain coffee cups, warm friendly natural light, candid documentary photography, vertical composition, no lanyards, no badges, no signage

beats.say: And once a year, we run Code Camp. A free day of talks, food, and people who get it.

show.prompt: a packed conference session room at a free one-day developer code camp, attendees watching a speaker, projector screen glowing, energetic professional atmosphere, candid documentary photography, vertical composition

beats.say: We love code. Come find us at C V dev group dot org.
